body: New PacketRespawn/PacketRespawnResult -- a KO'd player's only way back on this backend, apps2/mud's own real 'type home' flow (knockOut + HPState.Raise) reduced to its core mechanic via RaiseDefault. XP penalty always computed against 0 since real per-player XP tracking doesn't exist in apps2/server-go yet, named honestly in the code rather than silently wrong. RaiseDefault's behavior already covered by 5+ existing tests upstream, no new tests needed. go build/test clean. Commit aeaa567.
title: Respawn packet closes the KO loop in apps2/server-go
